adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new controller specs for Admin::EmbeddableHostsController and Admin::EmbeddingController that only test class inheritance (spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb). Meanwhile, the controllers introduce nontrivial behavior (Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create/update/destroy and save_host setting host/category_id with fallback to SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id when blank; Admin::EmbeddingController#show/#update returning serialized OpenStruct with EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)). None of this behavior (valid/invalid params, missing record handling, blank category fallback, destroy behavior) is covered by the new specs, making the finding accurate and diff-grounded as a test-coverage gap rather than a demonstrated runtime defect.
